title: μNode32U4 — ATmega32U4 USB dev board
scenario_title: Ring-down: pluck the crystal, watch it ring ~3,000 cycles — and decay
summary: 15.9968 MHz, τ=84 µs → Q≥4202; the chip must beat Rm=142 Ω to sustain it

checks.label: the ring is at the crystal's frequency (within 0.05% of 16 MHz)
the pluck produces a healthy millivolt-scale ring
…that outlives the burst by far (physics says τ = 2L/Rm ≈ 199 µs; the simulator's timestep adds damping of its own)
ring-down Q = π·f0·τ — a LOWER bound (step-size damped; the AC dip in crystal-resonance is the better measure)
